question: What is the height of the Kanchenjunga peak?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8598 m**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The height of the **Kanchenjunga peak** is **8598 meters**.
 
• Kanchenjunga is the **third highest mountain** in the world.
 
• It is located on the border between **Nepal and the Indian state of Sikkim**.
 
• The name Kanchenjunga translates to **"The Five Treasures of Snows"**, as it contains five peaks, four of them over 8,450 meters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kanchenjunga** was first climbed on **May 25, 1955**, by Joe Brown and George Band, members of a British expedition.
 
• The mountain is considered sacred by the people of Sikkim, and climbers traditionally stop just short of the summit to honor this belief.
 
• The region around Kanchenjunga is known for its rich biodiversity, including several species of rhododendrons, orchids, and various wildlife.
 
• Kanchenjunga is part of the **Himalayan range** and offers some of the most challenging climbs in the world due to its steep gradients and unpredictable weather.
